user.title: KNVB Rinus
user.description: Paste the full Cookie header from your logged-in Rinus session. In Chrome, open Rinus → F12 → Network → open your team profile → click 'profile' → Headers → Request Headers → Cookie. Right-click the Cookie value and choose 'Copy value'. Paste the complete value below. Do not use the 'Set-Cookie' line under Response Headers.

error.invalid_auth: The Rinus session cookie is invalid or expired. Make sure you copied the complete Cookie header from Request Headers.
